input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11 contains no exit mechanics: the only post-termination data provision is the mutual Confidential Information return-or-destroy sentence in 11.3, and nothing requires Commerce One to provide transition assistance or to export Corio's or its Customers' data on a defined timetable (the Section 12 escrow releases Source Code only on limited Release Conditions, not on expiry or termination). In a hosting agreement this absence fails even the fallback, so we insert a short Section 11.4 at the fallback level: at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of any expiration or termination. Preferred extras (then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) are not pressed.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination; and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers that is in Commerce One's possession or control.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no exit provisions, so we add a short Section 11.4 giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our and our Customers' data within 30 days of any expiration or termination. This is our fallback exit position; our preferred position would also add machine-readable format and certified deletion.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data export obligations in Section 11

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
